import numpy as np

# Individual income tax receipts (net of refunds) for fiscal years 1929-1942
# From treasury_bulletin_1942_07_page_76.txt - values in thousands of dollars

    1929: 1095541,

    1931: 833648,
    1932: 427191,

    1936: 674416,
    1937: 1091741,

import math

# Individual income tax receipts (net of refunds) for fiscal years 1929-1942
# From treasury_bulletin_1942_07_page_76.txt - values in thousands of dollars
data = {
    1929: 1095541,
    1930: 1146845,
    1931: 833648,
    1932: 427191,
    1933: 352573,
    1934: 419509,
    1935: 527113,
    1936: 674416,
    1937: 1091741,
    1938: 1286312,
    1939: 1028834,
    1940: 982017,
    1941: 1417655,
    1942: 3262800
}

# Convert to billions (thousands / 1,000,000)
years = list(data.keys())
receipts = [v / 1000000 for v in data.values()]

n = len(years)
print(f"Data points: {n}")
print(f"Years: {years}")
print(f"Receipts (billions): {receipts}")

# Calculate means
mean_x = sum(years) / n
mean_y = sum(receipts) / n

# Calculate slope and intercept using OLS formulas
# slope = Σ((x - x̄)(y - ȳ)) / Σ((x - x̄)²)
# intercept = ȳ - slope * x̄

numerator = sum((years[i] - mean_x) * (receipts[i] - mean_y) for i in range(n))
denominator = sum((years[i] - mean_x) ** 2 for i in range(n))

slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = mean_y - slope * mean_x

print(f"\nRegression results:")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")
print(f"Slope: {slope}")

# Predict for fiscal year 2000
predicted_2000 = intercept + slope * 2000
print(f"\nPredicted receipts for FY 2000: {predicted_2000:.4f} billions")

# Actual receipts for FY 2000 from treasury bulletin 2001_12

actual_2000_billions = actual_2000_millions / 1000

print(f"Actual receipts for FY 2000: {actual_2000_billions:.4f} billions")

# Calculate difference
difference = actual_2000_billions - predicted_2000
print(f"\nDifference (actual - projected): {difference:.4f} billions")
print(f"Rounded to nearest tenth: {round(difference, 1)}")

EOF

import math

# Data from 1942 bulletin (in thousands -> convert to billions)
data = {
    1929: 1095541,
    1930: 1146845,

    1932: 427191,

    1935: 527113,
    1936: 674416,
    1937: 1091741,
    1938: 1286312,
    1939: 1028834,
    1940: 982017,
    1941: 1417655,
    1942: 3262800
}

# Convert to billions

# OLS using standard formulas
n = len(years)
sum_x = sum(years)
sum_y = sum(receipts_billions)
sum_xy = sum(years[i] * receipts_billions[i] for i in range(n))
sum_x2 = sum(years[i] ** 2 for i in range(n))

slope = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x ** 2)
intercept = (sum_y - slope * sum_x) / n

print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")

# Predict for year 2000

actual_billions = actual_millions / 1000

print(f"Actual for FY 2000: {actual_billions}")

# Difference
diff = actual_billions - predicted
print(f"Difference (actual - projected): {diff}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest tenth: {round(diff, 1)}")
